Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
My minion has a .44 Magnum and rushes into combat with my prey's
minion. I play Dragon's Breath Rounds. My prey plays Direct
Intervention on the DBR. Can I play another one?

Dragon's Breath Rounds
Ammo
Card Text: Only usable before resolution of a gun's strike. That gun
inflicts +2 aggravated damage each strike for the remainder of this
combat. Burn the gun after strike resolution. This is an ammo card. No
more than one ammo card can be used on a gun each combat.

It has been ruled that you may not "play" a second Carrion Crows
during a given combat if the first has been Directly Intervened. So
what exactly is the difference between "used" and "played"? Does used
imply "successfully used"? If I have a DRB DI'd, can I then follow up
with Glaser Rounds?

Carrion Crows
Card Text:
Only usable before range is chosen.
ani:Opposing minion takes 1R damage each round of combat during strike
resolution. A vampire can only play one Carrion Crows each combat.
ANI:As above, but with 2R damage damage.

Thanks!

Jeff
